findings.body: The supplied close run exited with status 1 and explicitly lists install.spec.ts among the failed tests. The required three consecutive passing tests checks have therefore not been demonstrated. Investigate the install failure and obtain three consecutive passing checks. The excerpt does not include that test's failure trace, so its cause cannot be attributed to the new cleanup or timeout.
